scenarios.name: Inspect parameter column and cell context menus

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user creates a fourth model state named Model State1 and reactivates Copy State
the user opens the model-state table and adds parameter d0
the user adds angular parameter d1 to the table
The MCAD Software displays a four-member model-state table with angular parameter d1 included
the user right-clicks the d1 column header
the column context menu offers Delete Column
Key, Custom Parameter Column, range and increment commands are disabled
file-name, appearance and material column commands are disabled
the user presses Escape and right-clicks a d1 member cell
the cell context menu offers Insert Row, Delete Row, and Delete Column
the default-row, compare-base-row, custom-parameter, range and increment commands are disabled
the context menu closes and the table remains open
